title: A time you interviewed a famous person

bullets: when and where you interviewed this person
what you talked about during the interview
and explain how you feel about the experience

part2.question: Describe a time when you interviewed a famous person

segments.v: I want to talk about when I interviewed a famous chef. Her name is Ms. Vy. She won a cooking competition on TV and now she has a restaurant in Hà Nội. She studied at my school before. Last spring she came back to my school for the school anniversary. I am in the English club and my club interviewed her for our YouTube channel. I was the interviewer. We did the interview in the library. I was very nervous at first. She was very friendly and she made me feel relaxed. We talked about her job, her restaurant and her difficulties. She gave advice to students. I felt very happy and proud after the interview. Many people watched our video. I learned that famous people are also normal people.

fluency.band9: Who and why famous → context with humour → setting → nervous start and turning point with direct speech → topics → reflection on what makes a good interview.

lexical.band9: former student, anniversary, stumbled over, broke the ice, got into, quit, down-to-earth.

grammar.band6: “She studied at my school before” is fine but vague.
grammar.band9: Passive (was asked to interview her; I was chosen), past perfect (I'd prepared about ten questions), “so… that”, and “less about… and more about…”.

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 is accurate but flat (“I was the interviewer. We did the interview…”). Band 9 adds humour, a turning point with direct speech, and reflects on what makes a good interview.
